runner_id.description: Stable name of the runner instance, for logs.

credentials.description: The LLM credentials the runner holds and whether each is usable.

dropped_sessions.description: Pull-request keys whose session files the runner deleted since its last claim.

oneOf.description: Codex CLI signed in with a ChatGPT subscription.
